key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns policy mirror descent for terminal-reward RL into a trajectory-level objective using Bellman equations, eliminating the need to estimate intermediate state values.
engineering_relevance: This gives a critic-free training recipe for LLM reasoning that is simpler to implement and potentially more stable than value-function-based RLVR methods.
method: Reformulate PMD for autoregressive generation with terminal rewards via Bellman equations.
Optimize a trajectory-level objective instead of learning state values at intermediate states.
Use an approximated BPO loss with a mismatch-correction weight based on a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, where BPO demonstrates effectiveness for improving reasoning performance.
watch_item: Because BPO relies on an approximation to the reformulated objective, performance may depend on how well the mismatch-correction weighting is calibrated in practice.
